content.title: Match: Dating App for singles - Apps on Google Play
content.text: Match is more than just a dating app, it's a chance to experience a genuine relationshipWhat do Match members have in common? They're all committed to finding those truly special connections. You know, the kind that make you smile when someone asks "So, have you met anyone yet?" and make your heart skip a beat every time you get a new message.However, sometimes personal preferences can become a little too restrictive. A seemingly strange hobby, an imperfect smile, or a dog in a profile picture, and you swipe to the next person. But what if you met that person in real life and actually fell for them? Don't let a few minor details make you miss out on the potential to meet someone wonderful. Follow your heart, not your checklist.Why should you choose Match?📋 Detailed profilesLearn more about the people you meet on Match thanks to personalised descriptions and answers to all the important questions.✍️ Written promptsFun, creative questions to help you reveal what makes you unique.💬 Your core valuesPick the 3 values that matter most to you. This is a great conversation starter and helps you make deeper connections with others.💌 MessagesHave you and another Match member fallen for each other? Strike up a conversation for free!🎉 Speak-easy eveningsJoin us for an exclusive evening in a trendy, friendly venue, where every question matters. You'll chat and laugh together, supported by dedicated conversation guides, and allow things to unfold naturally.(Subject to availability and only in select locations across the UK, for now!)🔒 Photos and descriptions moderated within 24 hours*For profiles that comply with our standards.🛡️ A dedicated security centreBecause your peace of mind is our priority.🚀 On-demand features to maximise your chances💙 Super LikeA unique way to show genuine, authentic interest in someone.Super Likes help your chosen person notice your profile, and make it easier for you to attract their attention.👀 Private modeTwo features in one:You decide who can view your profile.Browse the app without appearing in search results.Want additional benefits? Why not purchase one of our Passes?💚 Essential PassUnlimited freedom to browse all profilesRevisit profiles you have already viewedSee who has liked your profileView all messages you have been sentBrowse freely, without adverts💗 Premium PassAll the benefits of the Essential package, plus:Send unlimited messagesSee who has viewed your profileUse the advanced search filtersShow all profiles that fit your criteriaSend up to 3 Super Likes a weekFind out when your messages have been read💎 Prestige PassAll the benefits of the Premium package, plus:Get 1 automatic Boost per day to enhance your visibilityStand out from the crowd with priority LikesAccess Prestige filters for highly personalised searchesProtect yourself from being left in the dark with our Anti-Ghosting featureDownload Match today and let your heart take the lead.Over 15.5 million people have already met someone on Match**📄 Our Privacy Policy:https://www.uk.match.com/pages/misc/privacy?styled=1📜 Terms and Conditions of Use:https://www.uk.match.com/pages/misc/terms?styled=1🛎️ FAQs:https://www.uk.match.com/faq/🔐 Safety tips:https://www.uk.match.com/safety/*All profile descriptions and photos are moderated.**Estimated number of people who have already met someone on Match (Meetic) in France, Italy and Spain. Calculated using Dynata survey results, carried out in December 2023 on 6,011 people over the age of 18 living in France, Italy and Spain, compared to the total population of this age group in these countries (Source: Eurostat 2023). The study found that 15% (in France), 12% (in Italy) and 10% (in Spain) of those surveyed said they had already met someone on Meetic. Question asked: Using any of the sites or apps, have you ever experienced the following, even if it was only once?I have already met someone via this site/app.
